scope: Offline synthetic scoring contract and sealed baseline arithmetic audit

findings.observed: 31 distinct card IDs covering 30 completed jobs are accepted. A second card for one job silently overwrites its first rating; synthetic history total changes from 120/120 to 116/120 while unique generation count stays 30.
findings.cause: Set coverage of mapping job IDs does not enforce one card per completed job before ratings[job_id] assignment.
findings.required_guard: Require len(mapping)==len(complete), in addition to mapped-job set equality, before processing ratings.
findings.collection_impact: None; existing runner export creates one card per complete answer. Fix via append-only analysis amendment before final scoring.

conclusion: Unique/shared accounting, denominators and complete-pair comparisons pass. Add one-to-one rating-map cardinality guard before final scoring.
